missions.requirement: add(a,b) must return the arithmetic sum of the two integers.
missions.testSource:
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('candidate',Path(__file__).with_name('candidate.py'))
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.add(2,3)==5
assert m.add(-3,2)==-1

missions.requirement: normalize(value) strips whitespace, collapses every run of internal whitespace into a single space, and lowercases text.
missions.testSource:
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('candidate',Path(__file__).with_name('candidate.py'))
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.normalize(' A  B ')=='a b'
assert m.normalize(' HeLLo ')=='hello'

import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('candidate',Path(__file__).with_name('candidate.py'))
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(m)
